attributes.action: End Public Sales of Fireworks & Require Displays to Be Registered and Advertised
attributes.additional_details: Unexpected fireworks can distress people with PTSD, including veterans, neurodivergent people and those with sensory or medical sensitivities. They can harm pets, livestock and wildlife. End over-the-counter sales and limit displays to licensed professionals. Require displays to be registered, with councils publishing dates, locations and start and finish times 28 days ahead, so residents can prepare. Encourage quieter fireworks and alternatives such as drone and light shows.
attributes.background: End over-the-counter firework sales and limit displays to licensed professionals. Require organisers to register displays and councils to publish dates, times and locations at least 28 days ahead, so people with PTSD or sensory sensitivities, and pet, livestock and wildlife owners, can prepare.

rejection.details:
